optimizedDescription.value: LadybugDB-backed GraphStore adapter providing Cypher query execution, FTS indexing, identity-ranked search, and CSV bulk loading.

optimizedContext.value:
# Ladybug Graph Store

## Rules

- `LadybugGraphStore` implements `GraphStore`; backend id `ladybug`; defer native binding readiness until `open()`; `close()` idempotent.
- Storage paths: database/lock/WAL under `{configPath}/graph`, CSV scratch under `{configPath}/tmp` (cleaned post-run).
- Schema & versioning: tables for `File`, `Symbol`, `Spec`, `Document`, `Meta`, and relation edges (`IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`). `COVERS_SYMBOL` preserves stale metadata. Versioning tracks schema; incompatible versions require `recreate()` full rebuild and `storage.epoch` rotation.
- Cypher safety: user/external values MUST use prepared statements (`conn.prepare`, `conn.execute`, `$param`, `Record<string, LbugValue>`); direct `conn.query` restricted to DDL, compile-time constants, internal COPY paths.
- FTS indexes: `symbol_fts` (`searchName`, `comment`), `spec_fts` (`title`, `description`, `content`), `document_fts` (`content`, paths), trigram source content index for queries ≥ 3 chars.
- Query processing: join multi-token queries with `OR`; supplement FTS candidates with identity hits.
- Reranking: exact canonical identity > exact token > prefix > suffix > real component > substring > content text.
- Bulk loading: single transaction/session with bounded CSV `COPY` chunks, commits once, rebuilds FTS once post-commit. Scratch in `{configPath}/tmp` cleaned post-run.
- Observations & latches: persists `IndexedInputObservation` records and workspace/global latches for incremental hydration.

## Constraints

- Infrastructure adapter; consumers depend on abstract `code-graph:graph-store`.
- Backend id `ladybug`.
- All persisted artifacts and scratch rooted under `configPath`.
- Parameterized Cypher MUST use prepared statements with `$param`.
